parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the major product of this two-step synthesis is benzene-1,3-dicarboxylic acid and not benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The reagents used for step 1 are $\text{CH}_3\text{COCl}$ and $\text{AlCl}_3$. These reagents give rise to $\text{CH}_3\overset{+}{\text{C}}\text{=O}$ ions which react with compound P.

Name the mechanism of this reaction.

parts.text:
